description: Yuan Shao, proud chinese warlord in the supplied pixel art style. An ornate gold helmet with a tall white plume, gold and black armor, a long purple cape, dark boots. He holds a straight sword in the right hand
face: A haughty face with a neat dark moustache and beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the gold helmet with the white plume, the long purple cape with gold edges covering the back, the sword at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Commander ready stance with a one-handed sword, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: Pointing the order. Frames 1-6 the sword is drawn back to the shoulder; frame 8 it is pointed sharply forward at the target; frames 9-11 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Direct diagonal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is raised to the upper right; frames 6-8 a big step and a cut from upper right to lower left; frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Direct thrust. Frames 1-5 the sword is drawn back beside the hip; frames 6-8 a big step and a straight thrust, point first; frames 9-11 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Noble authority. Frames 1-6 he draws himself up tall; frame 8 he thrusts the sword straight up high above his head, chest out; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a1 → a3 → b3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
